description: The Thames Estuary GIS collection publishes point and polygon layers labelled Infrastructure Projects, sourced from gov.uk. The description says boundaries inform Environmental Impact Assessment and help the Planning Inspectorate identify consultation bodies. It warns that site boundaries may change. These are planning-stage project extents, not proof of completed or operating infrastructure, and the exact project inventory was not downloaded. Coverage is the area represented in the published project layers. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides planning or policy-area inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the Thames Estuary built-environment and infrastructure catalogue members.
